//: Per-slug crop table for scripts/process-product-images.mjs. One row per product, in PLAN §2.4 order.
//focus: Focal point in 0..1 source coordinates (x from left, y from top). The crop window is centred on it, then clamped so it never runs off an edge.
//zoom: Fraction of the largest crop window the target ratio allows. 1.0 is widest, 0.4 is two and a half times as tight.
//frame: Which master in product-images/_masters/ supplies the frame. The schema holds one frame per ratio, so pick the best frame rather than the first one.
//ship: false keeps a product out of the manifest entirely. The reason is printed on every run and recorded in docs/IMAGES.md.
//alt: Describes the photograph, not the product. A screen reader reads it aloud, so it has to be true of the pixels — and the crop decides the pixels, which is why alt is per ratio rather than per product.

graphite-desk-pad.reason: Every candidate is a dark lifestyle desk shot. The primary has a laptop lid, two pencils and a second rule; -2 is an iPad with an Apple Pencil, a mouse and a plant; -3 is a keyboard and a mouse under an RGB monitor. Cropping to the felt mat alone leaves a featureless dark rectangle with no object in it. No crop makes any of them a product photograph.

alt.4x3: Knurled cast iron desk weight standing on pale concrete, lit hard from the left so its shadow falls sharply to the right.
alt.1x1: Close crop of the fluted cast iron desk weight on pale concrete, its shadow falling to the right.

oak-pen-cup.reason: The primary is a branded takeaway coffee cup on a dark background; the printed cafe name and logo stay legible at 640w, and PLAN §2.4 rejects a visible third-party logo outright. -2 is a decorated ceramic pen pot, -3 is a cup of highlighters with a legible brand. No crop fixes any of them.

alt.4x3: Engraved stainless steel rule lying across a white desk, its graduated scale and stamped numerals running corner to corner.
alt.1x1: Close crop of the engraved scale on a stainless steel rule, the graduations filling the frame.

alt.4x3: Plain cream canvas tote standing upright on a flat grey ground, its two handles arched above the body.
alt.1x1: Square crop of the cream canvas tote on flat grey, handles and full body inside the frame.

alt.4x3: Two cotton drawstring pouches on pale marble, a natural one in front and a slate-blue one behind it.
alt.1x1: Two cotton drawstring pouches on pale marble, the natural one in front with its black cord gathered at the mouth.

alt.4x3: Three notebooks fanned across a pale desk — a pink dot-grid, a kraft grid pad and an open white lined notebook — with two slim pens laid alongside.
alt.1x1: The open white lined notebook of a fanned stack, its blank page filling most of the frame.

alt.4x3: Close crop of a mechanical pencil's dark barrel and brass-toned knurled end cap lying on a pale desk, a hard band of sunlight across the metal.
alt.1x1: Tighter crop of the pencil's knurled end cap and barrel on a pale desk, cut by a hard band of sunlight.

technical-fountain-pen.reason: A macro of a nib with the maker's name engraved on it, legible at 640w, and the only master for the slug. PLAN §2.4 rejects an engraved brand name outright; shipping it would put a third-party trademark on the product page for a Kanso pen.
